# knowledge/index/ — Agent Instructions

The cross-reference layer over `use-cases/`, `components/`, and `apis/`.
Answer "what exists, and what links to what" from here — don't derive it
by scanning the other subfolders yourself, and don't hand-maintain a link
anywhere outside this folder.

| File | Answers |
|---|---|
| `use-cases.json` / `components.json` / `apis.json` | the full corpus, one row per artefact, with forward **and reverse** links, plus each artefact's real file `path`/`meta_path` — look an id up here, don't guess its path |
| `usecase-list.json` | every `TMFSxxx` id IG1228 knows about, **including ones not yet converted** (`planned`/`not available`) |
| `usecase-component-matrix.json` | IG1228's own corpus-level use-case↔component matrix, as TM Forum's own authors state it |
| `matrix-discrepancies.md` | where a use case's own document disagrees with that matrix — read **both** sources for a complete answer, this file doesn't say which one is "right" |
| `gaps-backlog.md` | capability gaps (proposed components/APIs that don't exist yet) TM Forum's own use-case authors already flagged, consolidated across every use case raising each one |
| `component-pdf-coverage.md` | which of the 6 no-PDF components are genuinely unpublished vs. specified-but-undocumented, and why |
| `id-registry.md` | the `TMFSxxx`/`TMFCxxx`/`TMFxxx`/`GBxxx`/`IGxxxx` prefix glossary — if you see an id prefix and don't know what it is, start here |
| `component-folder-map.json` / `api-samples-folder-map.json` | internal id→GitHub-folder lookup caches for `tools/fetch_*.py` — not meant to be read for general queries |

## Which files are generated vs. static

**Generated — never hand-edit, regenerate with `python tools/build_index.py`:**
`use-cases.json`, `components.json`, `apis.json`.

**Static, hand-maintained, never touched by any refresh script** (safe to
read as durable fact, and the only files in this folder you'd ever
hand-edit): `id-registry.md`, `gaps-backlog.md`, `matrix-discrepancies.md`,
`component-pdf-coverage.md`.

**Generated by a one-off extraction, not the routine refresh cycle:**
`usecase-list.json`, `usecase-component-matrix.json` (from
`tools/extract_usecase_list.py`/`extract_usecase_matrix.py` against
IG1228 — assisted track, re-run only when IG1228 itself is republished).

## Rules

1. A reverse link (e.g. "which use cases reference this component") only
   exists in `{use-cases,components,apis}.json` — never in the artefact's
   own file. Don't expect `component.yaml` to know who depends on it.
2. `gaps-backlog.md` is about *missing* capabilities (no id assigned at
   all) — not a general TODO list. The much larger pool of
   enhancement-request feedback to *existing* APIs lives in each use
   case's own "Impacts identified" section, deliberately excluded here to
   avoid drowning the handful of genuine gaps in noise.
3. Before citing this folder's data as current, remember it reflects the
   state as of its last refresh, not TM Forum's live site.
